The '''Troida Disruptor''' was a shield-disrupting weapon developed at the [[Troida Military Workshop]]. It was very effective, but required enough energy to power an entire city to work properly. During the [[Galactic War]] members of [[Balmorran resistance]] used the [[Disruptor/Legends|Disruptor]] to take down the shields over the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-controlled [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]], allowing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces to attack the city.
